raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?u
  where all
    match
      relation "have MFA disabled"
      role subject ?u
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be a user in the M365 tenant"
      role subject ?u
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  except ?u "the admins"
end
